subject: Upload of the file doesn't trigger if the path stayed the same, even if the file contents changed

messages.author: 2de7c33d05dd213b
messages.subject: Upload of the file doesn't trigger if the path stayed the same, even if the file contents changed
parts: The problem can be easily seen with runExample("09_upload"). If I upload a csv file for the first time, it works fine. But when I try to upload the modified version of it once again, the upload doesn't trigger. If the path to the file stays the same, then the second attempt to upload it fails, even if I opened and modified the file between attempts. options(shiny.trace=TRUE) shows that nothing is sent to the server in this case.
